Verify One tall upright trunk is stabilized by a continuous downward root mantle, visibly thickest and flared at the base. Eight long arching fronds emerge together at the terminal crown, each with seven opposite pairs of pinnae; each pinna bears five paired pinnules. Root bundles remain thin longitudinal root-like ridges, not overlapping bark scales or palm leaf bases; isolated tree, no pedestal. numeric_semantics: Integer component counts in parameters are mandatory construction choices, not fossil universals. All lengths, radii, thicknesses, widths and bounds are nominal artistic inputs; final transformed world geometry must be measured and disclosed. No normalization is planned, so component scale is preserved except grounding/centering translation.
contact_policy: Leaf/pinna/frond bases and root bundles must genuinely contact their supporting axis or lamina, with geometric penetration below the visible surface permitted. Measure actual world-space tagged vertex groups; inspect branching junctions and veins in multiple diagnostic directions. No visible coplanar surface interference.
